=== Move to an item in the same list makes the item its last child
--- given
- a
  - a1
- b‸
  - b1
- c
--- when move-to 0
--- then
- a
  - a1
  - ‸b
    - b1
- c

=== Move to a later item in the same list
--- given
- a‸
- b
  - b1
--- when move-to 1
--- then
- b
  - b1
  - ‸a

=== Move to a target inside the moved subtree is refused
--- given
- a‸
  - a1
- b
--- when move-to 1
--- then consumed
- a‸
  - a1
- b

=== Move to the item itself is refused
--- given
- a‸
- b
--- when move-to 0
--- then consumed
- a‸
- b

=== Move to a folded target unfolds it
--- given
- a ⊟
  - a1
- b‸
--- when move-to 0
--- then
- a
  - a1
  - ‸b

=== Move to keeps the moved item's own fold
--- given
- a
- b‸ ⊟
  - b1

  - ‸b ⊟
    - b1

    - b1

=== Move to a heading appends to the last list of its section
--- given
# One
- a‸
- b

# Two
- x
  - x1
- y

# Three
--- when move-to 4
--- then
# One
- b

# Two
- x
  - x1
- y
- ‸a

# Three

=== Move to a heading whose section has no list starts one after the section's last line

- b

# Two
some text

# Three
--- when move-to 4
--- then

# Two
some text

- ‸a

# Three

=== Move to an item in another list renumbers both lists
--- given
1. a‸
2. b

text

1. x
--- when move-to 5
--- then
1. b

text

1. x
  1. ‸a

=== Move to with whole items selected moves the run and keeps it selected
--- given
- a

- c⟩

text

- x
--- when move-to 7
--- then
- a
- d

text

- x
⟨  - b
  - c⟩

=== Move to a line that is neither a heading nor an item is refused

=== Move to a heading inside a code fence is refused
--- given
- a‸
- b
```
# not a heading
```
--- nodes 3 HyperMD-codeblock_HyperMD-codeblock-bg
--- when move-to 3
--- then consumed
- a‸
- b
```
# not a heading
```

=== Move to with the cursor outside a list does nothing
--- given
para‸graph
- a
--- when move-to 1
--- then passthrough
para‸graph
- a
